powers.name: Agility
powers.description: Your reflexes are honed.

powers.name: Speed
powers.description: You're quick on your feet.

powers.name: Strength
powers.description: You're strong and have no problem lifting.

powers.name: Vitality
powers.description: You're in a good shape and good health. At higher levels of vitality, you may even have a regenerative ability.

powers.name: Cold
powers.description: Brr. You can lower the temperature dramatically and shape ice to your whim.

powers.name: Cosmic
powers.description: The primal energies of the universe itself are yours to command.

powers.name: Electricity
powers.description: You command the lightning (or just a nearby powerline).

powers.name: Fire
powers.description: You can make everything burn.

powers.name: Infernal
powers.description: You can command the demonic energies of the underworld.

powers.name: Nuclear
powers.description: The splitting of the atom allows you to channel raw power and radiation.

powers.name: Radiant
powers.description: The light of the Heavenly Host is at your fingertips, ready to purge the world of evil.

powers.name: Sonic
powers.description: Focused waves of sound can be wielded to great effect, both for destructive vibration and for sound mimicry.

powers.name: Weather
powers.description: You can control the weather, including terrible storms and winds. If you want a more direct application of the weather's power, you can also take electricity or cold to supplement it.

powers.name: Signature Vehicle
powers.description: You have a custom vehicle that is nearly always on hand for you — it could be an awesome motorcycle, a tricked out van or even something like a magical surfboard. (Be sure to rename this power on your hero sheet to whatever your vehicle is.)

powers.name: Signature Weaponry
powers.description: You have a weapon that is almost like a part of you, from Fanatic's blade Absolution to Wraith's arsenal of knives. (Be sure to rename this power on your hero sheet to whatever your weapon is.)

powers.name: Invented Power
powers.description: There might be a specific power not otherwise covered by the powers listed here. With the GM's permission, you can add another power.

powers.name: Awareness
powers.description: You have enhanced senses that give you a broader range of awareness, covering everything from innate danger sense to superior sight and hearing.

powers.name: Deduction
powers.description: Your mind can make leaps of logic by analyzing details.

powers.name: Intuition
powers.description: You have strong gut feelings about what's going to happen and these feelings frequently lead to correct conclusions.

powers.name: Lightning Calculator
powers.description: You can perform intense feats of mathematics in your head in the blink of an eye.

powers.name: Presence
powers.description: You project your personality strongly over those you meet.

powers.name: Metal
powers.description: You can command and control metals, fashioning them to all kinds of shapes.

powers.name: Plants
powers.description: The plants of this world (and maybe beyond) respond to your thoughts, growing as you see fit.

powers.name: Stone
powers.description: You can shape stone and use it to build as well as destroy.

powers.name: Toxic
powers.description: You can manipulate toxic substances, including radioactive wastes and various poison gases.

powers.name: Transmutation
powers.description: You can transform non-living materials from one type to another. (To control them, also take other entries from this category in addition to transmutation.)

powers.name: Flight
powers.description: Look, up in the sky! It's you!

powers.name: Leaping
powers.description: Whether it's from immense strength or the proportionate ability of a bullfrog, you can leap through the air with ease.

powers.name: Momentum
powers.description: You build up momentum as you move and can channel it effectively.

powers.name: Swimming
powers.description: You are at home in the water and can propel yourself seamlessly through it. (At d8 or above, you also have no problems breathing underwater.)

powers.name: Swinging
powers.description: Via ropes or other devices, you can swing yourself across town, as long as you have something to grab onto.

powers.name: Teleportation
powers.description: Poof! You can disappear one place and reappear another. The greater the die value, the bigger distance you can go and the more control you have over the process.

powers.name: Wall-Crawling
powers.description: You can stick to walls and travel across them quickly.

powers.name: Animal Control
powers.description: Your mental abilities let you talk to and command non-sentient animals.

powers.name: Illusions
powers.description: You can weave convincing mental images to others.

powers.name: Postcognition
powers.description: You can experience visions of what has happened in the past to a person, place, or object.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.description: You have a limited ability to see into the future—or at least, a potential future.

powers.name: Remote Viewing
powers.description: You can project your senses to view another place at the same time.

powers.name: Suggestion
powers.description: You can influence minds to act based on your will.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.description: You can move things with your mind. The higher the die, the heavier the things and the more precision you have.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.description: You can send thoughts as well as read minds.

powers.name: Absorption
powers.description: You can absorb energy sent to you, and channel it into other forms.

powers.name: Density Control
powers.description: You can make yourself more or less dense to make yourself more resistant to harm or have a lighter step.

powers.name: Duplication
powers.description: You can make copies of yourself. Generally these copies won't be functional enough to act as full heroes, unless your abilities let you back this up.

powers.name: Elasticity
powers.description: You can stretch your entire body.

powers.name: Intangibility
powers.description: You can pass through solid objects.

powers.name: Invisibility
powers.description: You can make yourself unseen when needed.

powers.name: Part Detachment
powers.description: You can give someone a hand. Or any other limb, really.

powers.name: Shapeshifting
powers.description: You can change your form into something roughly the same size. Some shapeshifters have a limited number of forms they can take, while others are more mutable.

powers.name: Size-Changing
powers.description: You can increase or decrease your size, from a tall building to ant-sized.

powers.name: Gadgets
powers.description: You have access to a wide variety of useful technological tools for any given situation — generally built by somebody else.

powers.name: Inventions
powers.description: You can invent your own technological tools, and have some of your own inventions on you at all times.

powers.name: Power Suit
powers.description: You have a technological suit with a variety of built-in functions.

powers.name: Robotics
powers.description: You are able to create your own robot servitors.
